watchlist.description: Target — big-box consumer defensive retail

watchlist.description: ProShares VIX Short-Term Futures — volatility gauge, NOT a trade candidate
watchlist.notes: SIGNAL ONLY — never buy. judge.py score_volatility reads VIXY technicals as the VIX proxy for the Citadel sizing rule. Without it in the watchlist, every stock silently received a free full-weight volatility point and the 'reduce size when VIX > 25' rule never activated. max_allocation_pct 0 keeps it out of the buy path.
